name: Point Montara Light Station
description: Point Montara Light Station is a historic lighthouse on a bluff above the Pacific in Montara, about 25 miles south of San Francisco. It is home to HI Point Montara Lighthouse Hostel, which offers affordable dorm beds and private rooms.
fullDescription: Point Montara Light Station is a historic lighthouse on a bluff above the Pacific in Montara, about 25 miles south of San Francisco. It is home to HI Point Montara Lighthouse Hostel, which offers affordable dorm beds and private rooms.
whatTheyOffer:
- Dorm beds, private rooms, and family and group accommodations (fees apply)
- Shared kitchen, native plant garden, and outdoor picnic area
- Access to tide pools and a small cove beach
- Close to Montara State Beach and McNee Ranch trails
howToGetIt: Book online through Hostelling International USA or call 650-728-7177.
